thenational.basis: Publisher's own RSS feed: only the latest items it holds, so only recent deals can be checked
thenational.note: A feed holds a few days at most. A deal older than the feed's oldest item is marked as not checkable against it.

dfm.name: DFM disclosures (efsah)
dfm.publisher: Dubai Financial Market: disclosures filed by listed companies
dfm.basis: Company filings to the exchange, read from DFM's open disclosure feed
dfm.note: Only deals whose investor is a DFM-listed company can be checked here; most UAE state investors are unlisted or listed on ADX.

gdelt.name: GDELT article search
gdelt.publisher: GDELT Project: news articles from publishers worldwide, matched by company and deal wording
gdelt.basis: Open index of online news; each hit is credited to the publisher's own domain
gdelt.note: Covers about the last 90 days only and mostly English-language outlets. A deal is checked once; a failed query is retried on the next run.

unavailable.name: ADX announcements
unavailable.reason: ADX's terms of use prohibit systematic retrieval and it blocks non-browser clients; there is no compliant automated path without a commercial agreement. ADX-listed investors (AD Ports, ADNOC units, Alpha Dhabi, Space42, TAQA and others) cannot be checked against filings.

unavailable.name: SCA (Securities and Commodities Authority) disclosures
unavailable.reason: The regulator publishes news and circulars, not a feed of issuers' disclosures, so there is nothing machine-readable to match deals against.

unavailable.name: Non-listed investors' own filings (ADQ, Mubadala, MGX, EDGE, Masdar, DP World and similar)
unavailable.reason: Unlisted or state-owned investors file no public exchange disclosures; their own press releases are what WAM carries, so they are not independent of the WAM item.

unavailable.name: Reuters, Bloomberg and Financial Times
unavailable.reason: Paywalled or licence-only; no open feed, so they cannot be read.

unavailable.name: Gulf News, Khaleej Times, Zawya, Arabian Business, AGBI
unavailable.reason: No open RSS feed was found (404 or blocked for non-browser clients); a search by the wire text alone is not permitted.
